blogPost: Little Luxuries Under $25: Mini Splurges, Major Wow

banner.description: Banner image for blog post header - no text allowed
banner.prompt: A modern, whimsical illustration showcasing an elegant assortment of affordable luxury gifts arranged in a dynamic, isometric perspective. Include items like a beautifully wrapped gift box with ribbon, a scented candle with soft glow, a premium tea collection in elegant packaging, a small beauty set, artisan chocolates in a decorative box, a quality notebook with pen, and a silk sleep mask. Objects should have rounded edges, smooth matte surfaces, and soft shading. Use a gradient background transitioning from soft teal (#00A99D) to warm coral-orange (#FF6B35), with subtle abstract elements like small stars, dots, and geometric shapes scattered throughout. Soft, diffused lighting creates depth, with gentle shadows grounding each object. The composition should feel balanced yet dynamic, with objects at varying depths. No text, logos, or watermarks. Bright, optimistic, sophisticated atmosphere with ample negative space.
